content.value: The vanilla [[item/minecraft:loom|Loom]] serves as the [[article/tailoring|Tailoring Bench]]. It makes assigned bags, leather and textile equipment, saddles, and banner-related crafts. Banner recipes describe their actual pattern operations.
[[item/minecraft:bundle|Bundles]] are equipped as bags. Each [[item/minecraft:bundle|Bundle]] unlocks six player-storage slots; it no longer stores items inside the item itself.

The six corresponding bag-storage slots must be empty before a bag can be removed. Hovering an equipped bag highlights its storage slots. Bags stay with the player on death; their stored contents follow the bag-storage death rule.
[[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]] equipment salvage remains at the [[article/crafting_table|Crafting Table]].
